div.style: color: rgb(31, 60, 26) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
A one-time payment has no Pay::Subscription to delegate to — it is
its own record, matched on stripe_checkout_session_id so replaying the
same webhook or browser return never double-persists the same payment.
Same two entry points (webhook + browser return) as the subscription
flow share one StripeCheckoutSessionSync#call — it branches on whether
the Stripe Checkout Session carries a subscription.
